Reported values are numerically coherent: abs_cos_at_Lstar=0.0213, bootstrap mean=0.0156, random null mean=0.0133, theoretical random null=1/sqrt(3584)=0.0167, all in a plausible regime for near-orthogonal high-dimensional vectors. No suspicious rescaling or nonstandard normalization is indicated.
